feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED. The candidate defines exactly one predicate for each of the four declared propositions (blocker_moved, door_open, has_door_key, target_picked_up) and none for any undeclared proposition such as key_lost, which the machine does not use. All four bodies are single expression-only returns taking exactly env, use only allowed builtins (any, range) plus the documented scan idiom, guard possibly-missing values before attribute reads (cell is not None before .type/.color/.is_open, env.grid.get(x-1, y) is not None before .type, env.carrying is not None before .type/.color), mutate nothing, and touch no history or episode_memory, which is correct since all four are persistent readings of the current observation. Semantics check out against the grounding: blocker_moved is false only while a ball occupies the start-side cell left of the locked door, so a ball in hand counts as moved and dropping it back in front of the door turns it false again; door_open reads the current is_open of the (single) door; has_door_key requires carrying a key whose color equals a door's color, i.e. the matching door key; target_picked_up requires carrying a box whose color the mission string names in the documented 'pick up the <color> box' format. No invented API attributes, no sibling-predicate calls, no faked events.
